notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Mothdust Changeling.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Mothdust Changeling on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Mothdust Changeling and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Mothdust Changeling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
